visualCharacteristics.structure: intro h3 + p; accordion of details/summary items with chevron on a light rounded panel
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile/tablet; from 1024px intro in columns 1-3 (sticky) and accordion panel in columns 5-12

contentPattern:
Row 1 (optional, single cell): [h3 + p intro]. Rows 2..n: [question] | [answer: text with

breaks, or rich text]. Rows without an answer are skipped. Emits FAQPage JSON-LD into document.head once per block.
